description: Creates an API key for the organization and returns the secret once. Store it in an environment variable (GEOCODE_API_KEY); it cannot be shown again. The key acts in this organization only, with its creator's role (at most admin), and keeps working if the creator leaves until an admin revokes it. Needs an API key or a connected account.
